# ogsfrompoly-lp

> Source for ogsfrompoly.com — the public landing page for the poly-track Polymarket skilled-trader detection project. Astro (SSR) on Cloudflare Workers; Tailwind v4; Astro content collections for markdown.

This file is the **developer / agent index for the repository itself**. The public-facing `/llms.txt` served at `https://ogsfrompoly.com/llms.txt` is a different artifact — generated at build time from the published content collections by the Feed Generators module (issue #4) — and lists every published `.md` URL for LLM consumers of the site.

## Project

- [Project overview (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md)](AGENTS.md): stack, project structure, scripts, conventions, disclosure policy
- [README](README.md): human-facing project intro + quick start
- [PRD #1](https://github.com/auditmos/ogsfrompoly-lp/issues/1): scope, user stories, validation strategy
- [Implementation plan](plans/ogsfrompoly-lp.md): phased vertical slices and architectural decisions
- [Open v1 issues](https://github.com/auditmos/ogsfrompoly-lp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Av1): grabbable slices for v1 launch
- [Open v2 issues](https://github.com/auditmos/ogsfrompoly-lp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Av2): deferred until v1 ships

## Architectural decisions (load-bearing)

- **Content storage**: markdown in `src/content/` via Astro content collections. No CMS, no submodule, no runtime fetch from upstream.
- **Content schema = cross-repo contract**: Zod frontmatter is the stable interface between this repo and the future poly-track CLI producer. Breaking changes require a `SCHEMA_VERSION` bump.
- **Dual-format invariant**: every content entry must resolve at both `/<collection>/<slug>` (HTML) and `/<collection>/<slug>.md` (`text/markdown`). No per-route boilerplate.
- **Distribution model**: RSS + `.md` feed only. No email capture, no newsletter, no comments.
- **Disclosure policy**: methodology + aggregate results only. Wallets appear only as truncated/hashed IDs (e.g. `wallet_a3f…`). Live alpha never published.
- **Hosting**: `ogsfrompoly.com` via Cloudflare custom domain (zone already active); cookie-less Cloudflare Web Analytics.
